title: What If All the Continents Merged Into One?

scenes.text: What if all the continents merged into one? Scientists say it's coming, and it's rough on mammals.
In about 250 million years, the continents are projected to join into one supercontinent, nicknamed Pangea Ultima.
Most of that land would sit far from any ocean, so the interior would bake. Temperatures of forty to fifty degrees Celsius are projected.
The Sun will also be about two and a half percent brighter, and carbon dioxide could be double today's level.
A University of Bristol study found only eight to sixteen percent of that land might stay habitable for mammals.
The models assume humans have stopped burning fossil fuels. The heat comes from the supercontinent itself.
